subject: physics
title: How does temperature difference affect voltage generated in a thermoelectric setup?
abstract: This experiment aims at showing how the temperature difference between two junctions of a thermoelectric setup - a hot one and a cold one affects the voltage generated.Two Vernier thermocouple probes were used to measure the temperature which could see on Loggerpro,while a multimeter measured the voltage generated in millivolts.The temperature was varied by changing the temperature of the hot and cold junctions.The results are supposed to show a linear relationship between ΔT and voltage, consistent with the equation V = S·ΔT, where S is the Seebeck coefficient of the thermocouple material.This experiments helps show a fundamental principle of thermoelectricity which can have direct applications in our life
